notes: Input study identifiers, neutral description and test locators were empty. The supplied primary replication report explicitly identifies Study 2 and the focal enjoyment/preference test, allowing target identification independently. Original does not print Cohen's d for that test; the printed t statistic is retained without conversion. Original PDF text extraction renders equals signs as p; the quoted source text preserves that extraction. Replication d is retained with its printed positive sign; authors state the replication effect direction is opposite original. Replication extraction uses final pooled confirmatory N=1125, not stage 1 N=380 or supplementary N=1101. Supplied reference date differs from report metadata (OSF file modified June 2020); project title and team match.
